flags.message: The provisioned record/documents/brief-in-opposition.txt bundles two distinct filings under one 'brief-in-opposition' entry: the Feb 13 2026 brief in opposition and the Aug 2026 respondent's brief on the merits (documents.json shows the entry with entry_date 'Aug 03 2026' and two PDF URLs joined by '|'). Legitimate forward-mode input and it materially helped this grant-moment merits cell, but the kind label under-describes the content, and the petitioner's merits brief (filed Jun 08 2026) was not provisioned, leaving the merits advocacy one-sided in the record.
